Terminology bank departures needing an owner ruling (style guide ## Terminology bank; do not change the bank to secure a pass): Assessment prose جانچ vs bank تشخیص (42x); Slow Learner prose سست طالب علم vs bank کمزور متعلم; Learning Outcome prose تعلیمی نتائج vs bank نتیجہ ہائے تعلم; Labelling unbanked and rendered لیبل/لیبلنگ/ٹھپا. Either bank the prose forms as accepted pairs (as was done for Summative Assessment) or require the banked forms in prose.

Semantic drift (minor): topic-02.ur line 21 'اور اس کے بجائے وہ کیا کر سکتی تھی' renders 'what she could do instead' as a counterfactual past ('could have done'), while the following activity asks what the teacher could do 'starting tomorrow' (present/future). Consider 'کیا کر سکتی ہے'.

Register (minor): 'I am stupid' -> 'میں نالائق ہوں' softens the child's self-talk; نالائق means incapable rather than stupid. Consider 'بیوقوف' if the stronger force is intended, or keep as a deliberate softening.
Formatting parity: topic-02.ur Further reading presents the Westwood and Florian descriptions as bullets; the English runs them inline. Content is complete; only the list style differs.

RTL typography: topic-01.ur line 58 uses '(ADHD - Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder)' with a spaced hyphen inside a Latin parenthetical in RTL prose; style guide v4.6 prefers a colon for elaborating clauses. Consider 'ADHD (Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder)' with the expansion inside the parentheses.
